purpose: Define propagation of the authenticated origin identity across internal and remote requests so transports, proxies, peers and service instances cannot silently substitute a different semantic identity.

topics.name: Identity Propagation
topics.purpose: Define propagation of the authenticated origin identity across internal and remote requests so transports, proxies, peers and service instances cannot silently substitute a different semantic identity.

operations.name: Bind preserved identity to remote policy evaluation

semantics.origin_rule: Identity originates at the authenticating origin boundary.
semantics.propagation_rule: Requests/messages carry explicit origin identity context through governed hops.
semantics.transport_rule: Transport/session identity is not a substitute for semantic user/org identity.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote authorization evaluates the preserved origin identity according to remote policy.
semantics.proxy_rule: A proxy/service may act on behalf of an identity only when delegation/on-behalf-of semantics are explicit.
semantics.trace_rule: Identity propagation retains provenance across hops.
semantics.privacy_rule: Only identity data required by the owning policy/context should be propagated; propagation is not unrestricted disclosure.

invariants.rule: Identity assurance, authorization, remote delegation and activation state remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: transport/session id silently substitutes semantic identity
proxy/service invents or replaces origin identity without explicit delegation
remote policy evaluates a different identity because origin context was lost
payload self-asserted identity trusted without origin authentication
unnecessary identity data propagated without owning policy need

references.purpose: Remote DWH access evaluates the preserved origin identity.

prose.summary: Define propagation of the authenticated origin identity across internal and remote requests so transports, proxies, peers and service instances cannot silently substitute a different semantic identity.
